definitions.explanation: The outer edge or boundary of an object, typically the strip of material running along the perimeter. Used for the fabric border of tatami mats, the rim of dishes, the edges of pools and roofs, and similar perimeter areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破|やぶ}れた→破れる：02322_yabureru⟧。
examples.english: The brim of the hat tore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}まない→踏む：01197_fumu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: Walk without stepping on the edge of the tatami mats.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}けて⟦{話|はな}していた→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: They were talking while perched on the edge of the table.

notes:
Refers to the visible edge or trim of an object — often a strip of fabric, wood, or other material along the perimeter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり}: the cloth border of a tatami mat
- ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり}: the brim of a hat
- ⟦お{皿|さら}→お皿：02894_osara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり}: the rim of a plate
- ⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり}: the edge of a pool

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese etiquette, you do not step on the ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|へり} — both as a matter of respect and because the cloth border wears out faster than the woven surface.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧: end; edge — the endpoint or tip of something, not necessarily a decorative border
- {縁|ふち}: edge; rim — same kanji, broader meaning of any rim or boundary line
- ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧: same kanji, completely unrelated meaning ('connection, fate')
